categories.label: Ships
categories.hint: Sum of VP printed on your Ships on the Fishing track.

categories.label: Buildings
categories.hint: Sum of VP on your Buildings; asterisk (*) buildings score per their card condition.

categories.label: Issued shares
categories.hint: 1 VP per issued Share in your possession, any color.

categories.label: Gold
categories.hint: 1 VP per gold in your personal supply.

categories.label: Free building spaces
categories.hint: -1 VP per free Building space on your Harbor board.

categories.label: Unissued shares
categories.hint: -1 VP per Unissued Share in your possession.

categories.label: Guests in supply
categories.hint: Guests (Besøkende deck): 1/2 VP each, not rounded.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game lasts 7 rounds. Building VP are printed on cards; asterisk buildings (and Harbor Installation, 2 VP per Ship) depend on card text, so enter the computed VP in the buildings category. Some buildings let you cover negative-VP spaces with wood at game end (see card). Solo/advanced solo: same scoring, goal is highest score (30-40 is good).
